subject: repo-fleet
reason: Fleet extends the MPK task/event runtime with XCD-aware placement and hierarchical signaling.

subject: repo-tirx
reason: The TIRx MegaMoE path is an implementation-stack port of the DeepGEMM MegaMoE design lineage.

subject: repo-flashinfer
reason: FlashInfer exposes a DeepGEMM-derived MegaMoE backend among its MoE EP backends.

subject: repo-pdl-reconstruction
reason: The PDL chain preserves multiple kernels while reconstructing the scheduling effect of the matched persistent MegaKernel.

subject: repo-streamep
reason: Both overlap MoE communication and compute, but StreamEP uses multiple kernels/two streams while TeraMoE uses one cooperative persistent kernel.

subject: repo-qwen-megakernel
reason: qwen_megakernel leaves LM head/argmax outside its main kernel, while model-as-a-kernel closes the full greedy generation loop in one launch.

subject: repo-deepgemm
reason: MegaMoE includes expert compute between dispatch and combine; DeepEP alone is the communication boundary.

subject: repo-machete
reason: Both use resident instruction replay and scratch-page concepts, but expose different operator and schedule abstractions.

subject: repo-automegakernel
reason: Both expose task programs; AutoMegaKernel emphasizes agent-editable counter-DAG schedule search, while MPK emphasizes a more dynamic event/worker runtime.

subject: repo-aws-nki
reason: Both keep multi-stage model execution device-resident, though one is an NKI program and the other a CUDA persistent launch.
